exposure: age at first seizure, poly-therapy at NICU discharge, structural brain abnormalities related to seizure etiology, increased spike activity on EEG, burst suppression on EEG, normal EEG
cohort: The study included 157 neonates who experienced seizures during the neonatal period.
finding: Younger age at first seizure, poly-therapy at NICU discharge, structural brain abnormalities, and certain EEG abnormalities (increased spike activity, burst suppression) were associated with a decreased likelihood of anti-seizure medication cessation before 12 months, whereas a normal EEG increased this likelihood.
